summary: Test seam for the production TUI loop: run_async_with_remote's body moved verbatim into private run_tui_loop(agent, profile, remote, io: TuiIo). run_async_with_remote passes TuiIo::Terminal (real crossterm events, CrosstermBackend, TerminalGuard); the new #[doc(hidden)] pub run_async_with_harness(agent, TuiHarness { events: mpsc::Receiver<Event>, screen: Arc<Mutex<TestBackend>> }) passes TuiIo::Harness (scripted events, shared TestBackend, detached guard). The 5 event::poll/read calls in the loop now go through LoopEvents; frames go through LoopBackend (enum over CrosstermBackend/TestBackend implementing ratatui Backend). tests/tui_task.rs drives keys + bracketed paste -> Enter -> ScriptedBackend streamed answer -> resize -> /quit, snapshots the Conversation pane from the TestBackend buffer and the durable session turns, and pins that harness and binary share run_tui_loop.

validation_result.tui_task: pass: 2 passed (production_loop_streams_an_answer_and_exits, harness_and_binary_share_the_production_loop); 5 consecutive reruns green, ~1.8s each
validation_result.tests_tui_star: pass: all 15 tui_* integration binaries green

notes: Same-function proof: run_async_with_remote and run_async_with_harness are both one-line calls into run_tui_loop (the only definition), and core.rs RunMode::Tui -> run_async_with_profile -> run_async_with_remote; harness_and_binary_share_the_production_loop asserts this wiring from source. run_interactive (legacy) now wraps its CrosstermBackend in LoopBackend::Terminal because the external-editor helpers take Terminal<LoopBackend>. Harness mode uses TerminalGuard::detached() (no raw mode/signals/panic hook), so the external editor reports unavailable. Scripted input disconnect ends the loop with an IO error instead of idling. The harness still runs the real side workers (resource/LAN/Gantt/shell pane); the test sets ZENPI_HOME to a tempdir and SHELL=/bin/sh. Enter is sent 250ms after typing because the loop correctly folds an Enter within the 120ms ordinary-paste window into the draft. No new non-test unwrap/expect/panic!, unsafe, or Arc<Mutex> in src (the TestBackend Arc<Mutex> is shared with the test caller to observe frames); test uses unsafe env::set_var with a SAFETY comment.
